exposure: Physical activity (30 minutes walking at least 3 times/week)
cohort: Single pregnant women with a Body Mass Index (BMI) of >=25 kg/m2, enrolled at the 1st trimester.
finding: An early behavioral intervention consisting of a low-glycemic-index diet and physical activity in overweight/obese pregnant women significantly reduced the occurrence of gestational diabetes mellitus, pregnancy induced hypertension, and preterm birth.
